answer: Each identity files a prism artifact from an oasis workshop and locks a 70-credit bond. Ocean sand polishes it, its facets are key-cut, and its pattern enters a registry. Auditors inspect facets and registry each epoch; a duplicate pattern or reused cut burns the bond. Cutting is 29 credits, rising 8 per identity: the kth fake pays 29+8(k-1), the 1000th 8021; 1000 fakes pay 4,025,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-artifact ring fails: its prism carries its owner's cut marks, so one pattern under two keys burns both bonds. Honest oasis operators pay 29 once and recover the bond after an epoch.
